title: Research audit: 63 uniform T16 moment orders and three exact crossings (no new kappa)
body:
Research audit; no new kappa or construction. This classifies all 66 pairs of the twelve accepted same-word T16 packing profiles in batch1099. Sixty-three pairs have a strict native-complex moment order throughout 0<a<1; three pairs genuinely reverse order, with exact integer-power sign certificates.

The inherited majorization argument certifies 62 pairs. A short strictly-concave exponential tangent proof, reduced to the integer inequality 7^35 > 3^12 * 16^16, resolves the remaining uniformly ordered pair (PR1053 to PR1055). The real crossing pairs are PR1050 to PR1053, PR1074 to PR1087, and PR1082 to PR1087. The selected PR1094 profile still strictly dominates every other profile in this bounded domain for all 0<a<1.

The package pins base dd6403f774a0891093a006ae9716c02e371b1fdb, all twelve reviewed source heads, immutable replay archives and extracted receipt members. Physical construction admission and root certificates are explicitly reused evidence. Changed overhead/surcharge contracts are excluded. No selected-frontier or upstream files change.

Validation:
- Python 3.12.13 registered replay passes: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-moment-order-audit`.
- All 66 pair certificates replay; 17 rejection controls pass.
- Five tests pass, including all 1,191 equal-mass small-multiset pairs and independent rational-power enclosure checks.
- Python 3.14.7 optimized (-O) verifier and tests pass; source metadata/pins and git diff checks pass.

This extends the concrete evidence behind the PR1048 fixed-score warning without repeating PR1182's root-bracket audit. Credit belongs to Jeremy Kothe, Rohan Arun, Hao Yan, icekylinx, Josie Elliston, Sagar Thakrar, Douglas Colkitt and the retained supplier ancestry; detailed attribution is in the README. Prepared by mightyOil with substantial OpenAI Codex / GPT-6 Astra assistance in derivation, implementation, verification and documentation. Apache-2.0.
